name: Ghoul Rib
summary: In Duskwood, Abercrombie gathers Ghoul Rib to guard his shack from the dead. He says a fearsome effigy will frighten the flesh-eating horrors away from his home.

sections.title: A Gruesome Ward
sections.body:
Ghouls haunt Duskwood in many forms. Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones and Plague Spreaders are among them.

Abercrombie lives alone in a shack north of Raven Hill Cemetery. He asks travelers for their sturdy, rotted ribs. His home lies beyond the Night Watch’s protection in Darkshire, so he says he needs a fearsome effigy to frighten the dead away.

sections.title: Suspicions Around the Shack
sections.body: Abercrombie’s request for ghoul parts raises questions. Darkshire’s palisades could offer shelter, and consecrated wards might guard his home. Yet the hermit insists on gathering raw necromantic remains to protect his secluded shack.

faq.answer: Several kinds of ghouls in Duskwood carry Ghoul Rib. They include Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones and Plague Spreaders. These creatures haunt old graveyards, roadside ruins and abandoned homesteads across the forest.

faq.q: Why does Abercrombie want these bones?
aliases: what does abercrombie do with ribs
faq.answer: Abercrombie says his home lies too far from Darkshire for the Night Watch to protect him. He asks for ribs to build a crude scarecrow or effigy that he believes will keep roving undead from his walls.

faq.q: Do scarecrows actually keep ghouls away?
faq.answer: Ghouls are driven by hunger or dark necromantic force and generally feel no fear. Abercrombie still insists that a scarecrow made of bones will keep his home safe.

aliases: where to turn in ghoul ribs
faq.answer: Abercrombie’s shack stands in western Duskwood, just north of Raven Hill Cemetery.

angles.text: Handling the desecrated bones of the restless dead is grim work. Helping an isolated hermit face ravenous horrors fits your paladin’s duty to guard the living in Duskwood.
The twisted force that reanimates these bones shows the deep shadow over Duskwood. Fallen villagers become ravenous scavengers.
